structural_breaks.note: Ind AS adoption (transition 2016-04-01). FY2016Q4-FY2017Q4 values are Indian GAAP, net of excise; FY2018 statements carry Ind AS comparatives gross of excise.

GST: revenue for Apr-Jun 2017 and all comparative periods before it are gross of excise; from Jul-2017 net of GST (note 4, Sep-2017 & Dec-2017 statements). YoY for FY2018Q2-FY2019Q1 not like-for-like (flagged per point in pyc_basis).

FY2019/FY2020 comparatives re-presented in the Mar-2020 statement (reclassification between other income and revenue: e.g. Jan-Mar 2019 2,842.51 -> 2,864.43; Oct-Dec 2019 4,806.86 -> 4,817.77 INR mn). prior_year_comparative uses each statement's own comparatives.
Presentation unit changed from INR million to INR lakh (no scope change); values converted back to INR million.

profile.products: Transformers (distribution & power; Vadodara transformer factory existing capacity 5,500 MVA, expanding to 7,000 MVA), medium-voltage switchgear/panels, RMUs, vacuum interrupters & VCB breakers, protection relays, distribution management/smart-grid software, E-house/switchyard projects, services (AR 2025-26 p.35-38). Single reportable segment (note 3 of each statement). Exports 11% of turnover to 49 countries (BRSR, AR p.175).

plants.products: Transformer factory (5,500 MVA capacity; +1,500 MVA expansion)
SLW factory (vacuum interrupters, VCB breakers, relays)
Kolkata Medium Voltage Component (KMVC) factory — operations started Jan 2026

profile.end_markets: Indian power distribution utilities, renewables, conventional power, oil & gas, mining & metals, transport (metro/rail), data centers, semiconductors, industry, commercial buildings; exports 11%.

proxy_routes.why: 인도 전기장비(NIC 27) 생산 — 매출 89% 내수(배전 변압기·MV 개폐기)
인도 자본재 생산 — 산업·인프라 설비투자 사이클
인도 중형(650kVA-10MVA) 변압기 수출 — 업계 공통 사이클·수출 11%
인도 소형 유입 배전변압기(≤650kVA) 수출 — 배전 변압기 업황
미국의 인도산 >1kV 배전반/패널 수입 — MV 패널 수출(소규모)
배전망 개선(RDSS) 집행액(Ministry of Power) — 배전 변압기·RMU 수요
인도 데이터센터 용량 증설(MW) — AR상 수주 성장 동인

collection_notes: Company IR site (se.com/in, download.schneider-electric.com) blocks this environment (HTTP 403); all statements taken from BSE Reg.33 filings (scrip 534139) listed via api.bseindia.com AnnSubCategoryGetData and downloaded from bseindia.com xml-data/corpfiling.

FY2016Q4-FY2018Q3, FY2020Q2, FY2022Q4, FY2024Q4 statements are scanned images; values read visually and cross-checked with later comparatives and YTD/annual arithmetic.
A revised Q1 FY2018 (Jun-2017) statement was filed 2017-11-29; revenue unchanged (3,084.49).
